title: SHMI Overview
text: Soil Health Management Index (SHMI) turns record field management single 0-100 score. combines four sub-indices, also scored 0-100: Cover: season-weighted share days living plants. Diversity: many crop species grown, evenly, rotation. Inverse disturbance (InvDist): little soil tilled; 100 means disturbance. Organic inputs (OrgInput): often organic amendments applied animals present. vignette walks standard workflow: fill Excel workbook, prepare inputs, compute SHMI, review results.

Passes day processed shallowest deepest, disturbs fraction \(m\) soil still undisturbed within depth \(d\), overlapping passes double-counted: \(S_k = S_{k-1} + m_k (d_k - S_{k-1})\). daily value \(S / 30\), daily values summed within calendar year. "STIR": SD_mixeff holds STIR values. summed within calendar year, divided max_stir, truncated 1. Classes. annual tillage intensity (TI) placed Tier-3 class (left-closed, right-open intervals): Annual TI capped 1 classification ("EPA" sum daily values can exceed 1), class K covers 0.449-1 inclusive. TI replaced class representative chosen ti_rep: lower bound ("min"), midpoint ("mid"), upper bound ("max", official choice). Class Z always uses 0. annual score \(100 (1 - TI_{used})\), rotation score mean calendar years rot_start_yr rot_end_yr. Missing records. missing record means disturbance occurred (example, continuous -till): years without passes score 100, unit passes scores 100. Checks. Inputs checked chosen method. "EPA", every pass SD_mixeff > 0 needs SD_depth, SD_mixeff must lie within 0-1 (larger values look like STIR), depths 20 inches give warning may entered cm.
